source.text: וּבַשָּׁנָ֨ה הַשְּׁבִעִ֜ית הִתְחַזַּ֣ק יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־שָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֡וֹת לַעֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־יְרֹחָ֡ם וּלְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־יְ֠הוֹחָנָן וְלַֽעֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־עוֹבֵ֜ד וְאֶת־מַעֲשֵׂיָ֧הוּ בֶן־עֲדָיָ֛הוּ וְאֶת־אֱלִישָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י עִמּ֥וֹ בַבְּרִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And in the year the seventh strengthened himself Jehoiada and took the commanders of the hundreds, Azariah son of Jeroham and Ishmael son of Jehohanan and Azariah son of Obed and Maaseiah son of Adaiah and Elishaphat son of Zichri, with him in covenant.

en.L: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the commanders of hundreds, Azariah son of Jeroham and Ishmael son of Jehohanan and Azariah son of Obed and Maaseiah son of Adaiah and Elishaphat son of Zichri, [into] a covenant with him.
en.B: In the seventh year Jehoiada took courage. He brought the commanders of hundreds into a covenant with him: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
en.R: In the seventh year Jehoiada the priest found the courage to act. He made a covenant with the commanders who each led a hundred men. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah and Elishaphat son of Zichri.

es.L: Y en el año séptimo Joiada se esforzó y tomó a los jefes de cien, Azarías hijo de Jeroham, e Ismael hijo de Johanán, y Azarías hijo de Obed, y Maasías hijo de Adaías, y Elisafat hijo de Zicri, [en] pacto consigo.
es.B: En el séptimo año, Joiada cobró ánimo. Hizo un pacto con los jefes de cien: Azarías hijo de Jeroham, Ismael hijo de Johanán, Azarías hijo de Obed, Maasías hijo de Adaías y Elisafat hijo de Zicri.
es.R: En el séptimo año, el sacerdote Joiada se llenó de valor para actuar. Hizo un pacto con los jefes que mandaban cada uno a cien hombres. Eran Azarías hijo de Jeroham, Ismael hijo de Johanán, Azarías hijo de Obed, Maasías hijo de Adaías y Elisafat hijo de Zicri.

fr.L: Et la septième année, Yehoyada s’affermit et prit les chefs de centaines, Azaria fils de Yeroham, et Ismaël fils de Yehohanân, et Azaria fils d’Obed, et Maaséya fils d’Adaya, et Élishaphath fils de Zikri, [dans] une alliance avec lui.
fr.B: La septième année, Yehoyada prit courage. Il fit entrer dans une alliance avec lui les chefs de centaines : Azaria, fils de Yeroham, Ismaël, fils de Yehohanân, Azaria, fils d’Obed, Maaséya, fils d’Adaya, et Élishaphath, fils de Zikri.
fr.R: La septième année, Yehoyada le prêtre a trouvé le courage d’agir. Il a conclu une alliance avec les chefs qui commandaient chacun cent hommes. C’étaient Azaria, fils de Yeroham, Ismaël, fils de Yehohanân, Azaria, fils d’Obed, Maaséya, fils d’Adaya, et Élishaphath, fils de Zikri.

sw.L: Na katika mwaka wa saba Yehoyada akajitia nguvu, akawachukua wakuu wa mamia, Azaria mwana wa Yerohamu, na Ishmaeli mwana wa Yehohanani, na Azaria mwana wa Obedi, na Maaseya mwana wa Adaya, na Elishafati mwana wa Zikri, [kuingia] katika agano pamoja naye.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa saba Yehoyada alipiga moyo konde. Akawaingiza wakuu wa mamia katika agano pamoja naye: Azaria mwana wa Yerohamu, Ishmaeli mwana wa Yehohanani, Azaria mwana wa Obedi, Maaseya mwana wa Adaya na Elishafati mwana wa Zikri.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa saba Yehoyada kuhani alipata ujasiri wa kutenda. Akafanya agano na makamanda, kila mmoja wao akiongoza watu mia moja. Nao walikuwa Azaria mwana wa Yerohamu, Ishmaeli mwana wa Yehohanani, Azaria mwana wa Obedi, Maaseya mwana wa Adaya na Elishafati mwana wa Zikri.

vi.L: Năm thứ bảy, Giê-hô-gia-đa làm cho mình vững mạnh, và đem các chỉ huy trăm người, là A-xa-ria con trai Giê-rô-ham, Ích-ma-ên con trai Giô-ha-nan, A-xa-ria con trai Ô-bết, Ma-a-sê-gia con trai A-đa-gia và Ê-li-sa-phát con trai Xiếc-ri, [vào] giao ước với mình.
vi.B: Năm thứ bảy, Giê-hô-gia-đa can đảm hành động. Ông lập giao ước với các chỉ huy trăm người: A-xa-ria con trai Giê-rô-ham, Ích-ma-ên con trai Giô-ha-nan, A-xa-ria con trai Ô-bết, Ma-a-sê-gia con trai A-đa-gia và Ê-li-sa-phát con trai Xiếc-ri.
vi.R: Năm thứ bảy, thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa lấy can đảm để hành động. Ông lập giao ước với các chỉ huy, mỗi người chỉ huy một trăm quân. Họ là A-xa-ria con trai Giê-rô-ham, Ích-ma-ên con trai Giô-ha-nan, A-xa-ria con trai Ô-bết, Ma-a-sê-gia con trai A-đa-gia và Ê-li-sa-phát con trai Xiếc-ri.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 해에 여호야다가 스스로 힘을 내어, 백부장들, 곧 여로함의 아들 아사랴와 여호하난의 아들 이스마엘과 오벳의 아들 아사랴와 아다야의 아들 마아세야와 시그리의 아들 엘리사밧을 데려다가 자기와 언약을 [맺게 했다].
ko.B: 일곱째 해에 여호야다는 용기를 내어 백부장들을 불러 자기와 언약을 맺게 했다. 그들은 여로함의 아들 아사랴, 여호하난의 아들 이스마엘, 오벳의 아들 아사랴, 아다야의 아들 마아세야, 시그리의 아들 엘리사밧이었다.
ko.R: 일곱째 해에 제사장 여호야다는 마침내 용기를 내어 일을 시작했다. 그는 저마다 군인 백 명씩을 거느린 지휘관들과 언약을 맺었다. 그들은 여로함의 아들 아사랴, 여호하난의 아들 이스마엘, 오벳의 아들 아사랴, 아다야의 아들 마아세야, 시그리의 아들 엘리사밧이었다.

pt.L: E no sétimo ano Joiada se fortaleceu e tomou os chefes de centenas, Azarias, filho de Jeroão, e Ismael, filho de Joanã, e Azarias, filho de Obede, e Maaseias, filho de Adaías, e Elisafate, filho de Zicri, [numa] aliança consigo.
pt.B: No sétimo ano, Joiada criou coragem. Ele fez os comandantes de centenas entrarem numa aliança com ele: Azarias, filho de Jeroão, Ismael, filho de Joanã, Azarias, filho de Obede, Maaseias, filho de Adaías, e Elisafate, filho de Zicri.
pt.R: No sétimo ano, o sacerdote Joiada encontrou coragem para agir. Ele fez uma aliança com os comandantes que chefiavam cem homens cada um. Eram eles Azarias, filho de Jeroão, Ismael, filho de Joanã, Azarias, filho de Obede, Maaseias, filho de Adaías, e Elisafate, filho de Zicri.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 11:4-20 tells the same events; Chronicles names the commanders
decisions.reason: Verses 1-21 retell 2 Kings 11:4-20, often in the same words, and the wording here follows that chapter wherever the Hebrew is the same. Each difference is noted at its verse. Here Kings says that Jehoiada "sent and took the commanders of hundreds of the Carites and of the runners" and brought them into the temple; Chronicles says that he "strengthened himself", names five commanders, and does not mention the Carites or the runners.

decisions.choice: strengthened himself: took courage and acted firmly
decisions.reason: The verb form means to make oneself strong, to take courage for a hard task (2 Chronicles 1:1; 15:8). After six years of hiding the boy, Jehoiada now moves against Athaliah.

decisions.choice: took ... with him in covenant: bound them to himself by a covenant
decisions.reason: "Took" governs the five names, and "with him in covenant" says how: he made them parties to a sworn agreement with him, as in 2 Kings 11:4.

decisions.choice: commanders of hundreds: officers each over a unit of about a hundred men
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:4. The army and the guard were organized in units of thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens (1 Samuel 22:7).

decisions.choice: the priest; who each led a hundred men
decisions.reason: Readable says who Jehoiada was (verse 8; 22:11) and explains "commanders of hundreds", as in 2 Kings 11:4.

decisions.choice: took courage (Balanced); found the courage to act (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "strengthened himself" (m2).

decisions.choice: "los jefes de cien" (L, B); "los jefes que mandaban cada uno a cien hombres" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 11:4. The commanders' names in their usual Spanish forms: Jeroham, Johanán, Obed, Maasías, Adaías, Elisafat, Zicri.

decisions.choice: "Yeroham", "Yehohanân", "Maaséya", "Élishaphath", "Zikri"
decisions.reason: Names in the French forms of these books (y for the Hebrew y, ou/â/é as in "Yohanân" and "Benaya"); the story follows French 2 Kings 11:4-20 where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 11:4-20
decisions.reason: Chapter 23 retells 2 Kings 11:4-20; where the Hebrew is the same, the Swahili of Kings is kept at each level ("wakuu wa mamia" L, B; "makamanda" R; "Ushuhuda"; "Mfalme aishi milele!"), and it differs only where Chronicles differs.

decisions.choice: "các chỉ huy trăm người" (L, B); "mỗi người chỉ huy một trăm quân" (R)
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings 11 drafts' wording for the same officers, which Chronicles names (m1).

decisions.choice: "백부장들" (Literal, Balanced); "군인 백 명씩을 거느린 지휘관들" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Korean wording of 2 Kings 11:4, which Chronicles retells; the chapter keeps that draft's words wherever the Hebrew is the same (m1).

decisions.choice: Joiada; os chefes de centenas (L), os comandantes de centenas (B), os comandantes que chefiavam cem homens cada um (R); uma aliança
decisions.reason: Chapter 23 retells 2 Kings 11:4-20 (m1), and the Portuguese keeps that chapter's words level by level where the Hebrew is the same: "Joiada", the officers over a hundred (m4) and "aliança" as 2 Kings 11:4 sets them; each difference from Kings is followed and named at its verse. "Se fortaleceu" (L) and "criou coragem" (B) as 1:1 and 15:8 have the verb in Portuguese (m2).

decisions.choice: Jeroão, Joanã, Obede, Maaseias, Adaías, Elisafate, Zicri
decisions.reason: The names take the forms the Portuguese of Samuel and 1 Chronicles gives them ("Jeroão" 1 Samuel 1:1, "Joanã", "Obede", "Maaseias" 1 Chronicles 15:18, "Adaías", "Zicri"); "Elisafate", found only here, is formed the same way, with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant.

source.text: וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּקְבְּצ֤וּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֙ מִכָּל־עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְרָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they went around in Judah and gathered the Levites from all [the] cities of Judah and [the] heads of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

en.L: And they went around in Judah and gathered the Levites from all the cities of Judah and the heads of the fathers' [houses] of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
en.B: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites from all the towns of Judah and the heads of families of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
en.R: They traveled all through Judah and gathered the Levites from every town, along with the family leaders of Israel. Then they all came to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y recorrieron Judá y reunieron a los levitas de todas las ciudades de Judá y a los jefes de [las casas de] los padres de Israel, y vinieron a Jerusalén.
es.B: Recorrieron todo Judá y reunieron a los levitas de todas las ciudades de Judá y a los jefes de familia de Israel, y vinieron a Jerusalén.
es.R: Viajaron por todo Judá y reunieron a los levitas de cada ciudad, junto con los jefes de las familias de Israel. Luego todos vinieron a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et ils parcoururent Juda et rassemblèrent les Lévites de toutes les villes de Juda et les chefs des [maisons des] pères d’Israël, et ils vinrent à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ils parcoururent Juda et rassemblèrent les Lévites de toutes les villes de Juda et les chefs de famille d’Israël, et ils vinrent à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Ils ont voyagé dans tout Juda et ils ont rassemblé les Lévites de toutes les villes, avec les chefs de famille d’Israël. Ensuite ils sont tous venus à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Nao wakazunguka katika Yuda, wakawakusanya Walawi kutoka miji yote ya Yuda na vichwa vya [nyumba za] baba za Israeli, wakaja Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Walizunguka katika Yuda yote, wakawakusanya Walawi kutoka miji yote ya Yuda na wakuu wa jamaa za Israeli, wakaja Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Walisafiri katika Yuda yote, wakawakusanya Walawi kutoka kila mji, pamoja na viongozi wa jamaa za Israeli. Kisha wote wakaja Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Họ đi khắp Giu-đa và nhóm họp người Lê-vi từ mọi thành của Giu-đa, cùng các trưởng tộc của Y-sơ-ra-ên, rồi họ đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Họ đi khắp Giu-đa, nhóm họp người Lê-vi từ mọi thành của Giu-đa và các trưởng gia tộc của Y-sơ-ra-ên, rồi họ đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Họ đi khắp xứ Giu-đa và tập hợp người Lê-vi từ mọi thành, cùng với các người đứng đầu các gia đình trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Rồi tất cả cùng đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 유다를 두루 다니며 유다의 모든 성읍에서 레위인들과 이스라엘의 조상의 [집들의] 우두머리들을 모았고, 그들이 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.B: 그들은 유다를 두루 다니며 유다의 모든 성읍에서 레위인들과 이스라엘의 각 가문의 우두머리들을 모았다. 그리고 그들은 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.R: 그들은 유다 온 땅을 돌아다니며 모든 성읍에서 레위인들을 모으고, 이스라엘의 집안 어른들도 모았다. 그런 다음 그들은 모두 예루살렘으로 왔다.

pt.L: E percorreram Judá e reuniram os levitas de todas as cidades de Judá e os chefes das famílias de Israel, e vieram a Jerusalém.
pt.B: Eles percorreram todo o Judá e reuniram os levitas de todas as cidades de Judá e os chefes das famílias de Israel, e foram a Jerusalém.
pt.R: Eles viajaram por todo o Judá e reuniram os levitas de todas as cidades, junto com os líderes das famílias de Israel. Depois todos foram a Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: the Levites and the heads of the fathers' houses gathered from all Judah: not in Kings
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11 has nothing like this verse. There Jehoiada works with the officers of the royal guard; Chronicles shows the Levites and the family heads of the whole nation drawn into the plan, so that the crowning is the act of the whole assembly (verse 3).

decisions.choice: the heads of the fathers: the leaders of the ancestral families
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here is short for "fathers' houses", the extended families that made up a tribe (1 Chronicles 24:4). Their heads were the leading men of each family.

decisions.choice: Israel: the people of God gathered in Judah
decisions.reason: The heads of families come from the towns of Judah, but Chronicles calls them "of Israel", the name of the whole covenant people (2 Chronicles 11:3; 12:6).

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers' [houses] (Literal); heads of families (Balanced); family leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Chronicles (1 Chronicles 24:4, 6). Literal supplies "houses" in brackets (m2).

decisions.choice: "los jefes de [las casas de] los padres" (L); "los jefes de familia" (B); "los jefes de las familias" (R)
decisions.reason: The leaders of the ancestral houses, one wording per level as the English has (m2).

decisions.choice: "các trưởng tộc" (L); "các trưởng gia tộc" (B); "người đứng đầu các gia đình" (R)
decisions.reason: "The heads of the fathers' [houses]" are the leaders of the ancestral families (m2); Vietnamese has a ready word at Literal and says it more plainly at Readable.

decisions.choice: os chefes das famílias (L, B); os líderes das famílias (R)
decisions.reason: As 1:2 sets the "heads of the fathers" (m2) for the book: "famílias" at every level, so Literal needs no bracketed word. The verse has no parallel in Kings (m1).

source.text: וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת כָּל־הַקָּהָ֥ל בְּרִ֛ית בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עִם־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֶן־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־בְּנֵ֥י דָוִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And made all the assembly a covenant in [the] house of the God with the king. And he said to them, Look, [the] son of the king will reign, as spoke Yahweh concerning [the] sons of David.

en.L: And all the assembly made a covenant in the house of God with the king. And he said to them, "Look, the son of the king shall reign, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke concerning the sons of David.
en.B: In the house of God the whole assembly made a covenant with the king. Jehoiada said to them, "Here is the king's son! He shall reign, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised concerning the descendants of David.
en.R: There in God's temple the whole gathering made a covenant with the king. Jehoiada said to them, "Look, this is the king's son. He must be king, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised about David's descendants.

es.L: Y toda la asamblea hizo un pacto en la casa de Dios con el rey. Y él les dijo: «He aquí, el hijo del rey reinará, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló acerca de los hijos de David.
es.B: En la casa de Dios toda la asamblea hizo un pacto con el rey. Joiada les dijo: «¡Aquí está el hijo del rey! Él reinará, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo prometió acerca de los descendientes de David.
es.R: Allí, en el templo de Dios, toda la asamblea hizo un pacto con el rey. Joiada les dijo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, este es el hijo del rey. Él tiene que ser rey, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo prometió acerca de los descendientes de David.

fr.L: Et toute l’assemblée conclut une alliance dans la maison de Dieu avec le roi. Et il leur dit : « Voici, le fils du roi régnera, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a dit au sujet des fils de David.
fr.B: Dans la maison de Dieu, toute l’assemblée conclut une alliance avec le roi. Yehoyada leur dit : « Voici le fils du roi ! C’est lui qui régnera, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a promis au sujet des descendants de David.
fr.R: Là, dans le temple de Dieu, toute l’assemblée a conclu une alliance avec le roi. Yehoyada leur a dit : « Regardez, voici le fils du roi. C’est lui qui doit être roi, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a promis au sujet des descendants de David.

sw.L: Na kusanyiko lote likafanya agano katika nyumba ya Mungu pamoja na mfalme. Naye akawaambia, "Tazama, mwana wa mfalme atatawala, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema kuhusu wana wa Daudi.
sw.B: Katika nyumba ya Mungu kusanyiko lote lilifanya agano na mfalme. Yehoyada akawaambia, "Huyu hapa mwana wa mfalme! Yeye atatawala, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi kuhusu wazao wa Daudi.
sw.R: Pale katika hekalu la Mungu kusanyiko lote likafanya agano na mfalme. Yehoyada akawaambia, "Tazameni, huyu ndiye mwana wa mfalme. Ni lazima yeye awe mfalme, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi kuhusu wazao wa Daudi.

vi.L: Cả hội chúng lập giao ước với vua trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời. Ông nói với họ: "Kìa, con trai vua sẽ trị vì, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán về các con trai của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời, cả hội chúng lập giao ước với vua. Giê-hô-gia-đa nói với họ: "Đây là con trai của vua! Người sẽ trị vì, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa về dòng dõi Đa-vít.
vi.R: Tại đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời, cả hội chúng lập giao ước với vua. Giê-hô-gia-đa nói với họ: "Đây là con trai của vua. Người phải làm vua, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa về dòng dõi Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 온 회중이 하나님의 집에서 왕과 언약을 맺었다. 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "보시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗의 아들들에 관하여 말씀하신 대로 왕의 아들이 다스릴 것이오.
ko.B: 온 회중이 하나님의 집에서 왕과 언약을 맺었다. 여호야다가 그들에게 말했다. "여기 왕자가 계시오! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗의 자손에 관하여 약속하신 대로 이분이 다스리셔야 하오.
ko.R: 그곳 하나님의 성전에서 온 회중이 왕과 언약을 맺었다. 여호야다가 그들에게 말했다. "보시오, 이분이 왕자요. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗의 자손에 관하여 약속하신 그대로 이분이 왕이 되셔야 하오.

pt.L: E toda a assembleia fez uma aliança na casa de Deus com o rei. E ele lhes disse: "Eis que o filho do rei reinará, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou a respeito dos filhos de Davi.
pt.B: Na casa de Deus, toda a assembleia fez uma aliança com o rei. Joiada lhes disse: "Aqui está o filho do rei! Ele reinará, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} prometeu a respeito dos descendentes de Davi.
pt.R: Ali no templo de Deus, todo o povo reunido fez uma aliança com o rei. Joiada lhes disse: "Vejam, este é o filho do rei. Ele deve ser o rei, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} prometeu sobre os descendentes de Davi.

decisions.choice: the whole assembly makes a covenant with the king: Kings has Jehoiada and the commanders
decisions.reason: In 2 Kings 11:4 Jehoiada makes a covenant with the commanders, puts them under oath and shows them the king's son. Chronicles has the whole assembly make a covenant with the king himself, and gives Jehoiada's words about the promise to David, which Kings does not have.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh spoke concerning the sons of David: the promise of a lasting dynasty
decisions.reason: Yahweh had promised David that his descendants would sit on his throne (2 Samuel 7:12-16; 1 Chronicles 17:11-14; 2 Chronicles 21:7). Athaliah's attempt to wipe out the royal line (22:10) set itself against that promise; the hidden boy is its proof.

decisions.choice: with the king; the son of the king: Joash
decisions.reason: The boy Joash is already called "the king" before he is crowned. "The son of the king" is the son of the dead King Ahaziah.

decisions.choice: the assembly: the gathered people
decisions.reason: The assembly is the gathering of verse 2: the Levites and the family heads with the commanders, the people assembled before God.

decisions.choice: promised
decisions.reason: "Spoke concerning" here means a promise Yahweh made (m2); Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker, which the Hebrew leaves as "he".

decisions.choice: "habló" (L); "lo prometió" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the word was a promise (m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada speaks to the assembly in 하오체 ("보시오", "하오"), and the boy king takes the honorific (이분, -시-)
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings 11 draft gives Jehoiada 하오체 toward the commanders; the same level is kept here for the larger assembly, and the king is spoken of with respect even before his crowning (m3).

decisions.choice: a assembleia (L, B), todo o povo reunido (R); vocês (Jehoiada to the assembly)
decisions.reason: The assembly (m4) is "a assembleia", the Old Testament terms' word for *qahal*; Readable says who they were. Jehoiada's orders that begin here and run to verse 7 are spoken to many people, priests, Levites and family heads, so he says "vocês", as he does to the officers in 2 Kings 11:5 in Portuguese.

source.text: זֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֨ית מִכֶּ֜ם בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת לַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְלַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְשֹֽׁעֲרֵ֖י הַסִּפִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] the thing which you will do: the third of you, [those] coming in [on] the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, [as] gatekeepers of the thresholds,

en.L: This [is] the thing that you shall do: the third of you who come in on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, [shall be] gatekeepers of the thresholds,
en.B: Here is what you must do. One third of you who come on duty on the sabbath, priests and Levites, will be gatekeepers at the doorways,
en.R: Here is what you must do. The priests and Levites who come on duty on the sabbath will be divided into three groups. One group will be gatekeepers at the temple doors.

es.L: Esto [es] lo que {{plural_you:harán|haréis}}: la tercera parte de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que entran el sábado, de los sacerdotes y de los levitas, [serán] porteros de los umbrales,
es.B: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer. Una tercera parte de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sacerdotes y levitas, los que entran de servicio el sábado, serán porteros en las entradas,
es.R: Esto es lo que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que hacer. Los sacerdotes y levitas que entran de servicio el sábado se dividirán en tres grupos. Un grupo hará de porteros en las puertas del templo.

fr.L: Voici ce que vous ferez : le tiers d’entre vous qui entrent le jour du sabbat, d’entre les prêtres et d’entre les Lévites, [sera] portiers des seuils,
fr.B: Voici ce que vous devez faire. Un tiers d’entre vous, prêtres et Lévites qui prennent leur service le jour du sabbat, gardera les portes,
fr.R: Voici ce que vous devez faire. Les prêtres et les Lévites qui prennent leur service le jour du sabbat seront répartis en trois groupes. Un groupe gardera les portes du temple.

sw.L: Hili [ndilo] jambo mtakalofanya: theluthi moja yenu mnaoingia siku ya Sabato, wa makuhani na wa Walawi, [mtakuwa] mabawabu wa vizingiti,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya. Theluthi moja yenu, makuhani na Walawi wanaoingia zamu siku ya Sabato, watakuwa mabawabu kwenye milango,
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya. Makuhani na Walawi wanaoanza zamu siku ya Sabato watagawanywa katika vikundi vitatu. Kikundi kimoja kitakuwa walinzi wa malango kwenye milango ya hekalu.

vi.L: Đây [là] việc các anh phải làm: một phần ba trong các anh, những người vào phiên ngày Sa-bát, thuộc các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi, [sẽ] giữ cửa ở các ngưỡng cửa,
vi.B: Đây là việc các anh phải làm: một phần ba trong số các anh, là các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi vào phiên ngày Sa-bát, sẽ làm người giữ cổng ở các lối vào,
vi.R: Đây là việc các anh phải làm. Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi vào phiên trực ngày Sa-bát sẽ chia làm ba nhóm. Một nhóm làm người giữ cổng ở các cửa đền thờ.

ko.L: 당신들이 할 일은 이것이오. 당신들 가운데 안식일에 들어오는 제사장들과 레위인들 가운데 삼분의 일은 문지방들의 문지기가 되고,
ko.B: 당신들이 할 일은 이렇소. 안식일에 근무하러 들어오는 당신들 제사장들과 레위인들 가운데 삼분의 일은 성전 문들을 지키는 문지기가 되고,
ko.R: 당신들이 할 일은 이렇소. 안식일에 근무를 시작하는 제사장들과 레위인들을 세 무리로 나누시오. 한 무리는 성전 문들을 지키는 문지기가 되시오.

pt.L: Esta [é] a coisa que vocês farão: a terça parte de vocês, os que entram no sábado, dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, [serão] porteiros das soleiras,
pt.B: Vocês vão fazer o seguinte: um terço de vocês, sacerdotes e levitas que entram de serviço no sábado, vai ficar de guarda nas entradas como porteiros,
pt.R: Vocês vão fazer o seguinte. Os sacerdotes e os levitas que começam o serviço no sábado vão ser divididos em três grupos. Um grupo vai vigiar as portas do templo como porteiros.

decisions.choice: the same order as 2 Kings 11:5, given to priests and Levites
decisions.reason: The opening words are those of 2 Kings 11:5. There the men coming on duty are the royal guard and the first third keeps watch over the palace; here they are priests and Levites, and the first third guards the thresholds of the temple.

decisions.choice: coming in on the sabbath: coming on duty when the shifts changed
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:5. The priests and Levites served in divisions that changed on the sabbath (1 Chronicles 9:25), so on that day the outgoing and incoming groups were both at the temple (verse 8).

decisions.choice: the third of you: the men on duty are split into three groups
decisions.reason: One third guards the thresholds, one the palace and one the Foundation Gate (verse 5), while the people stay in the courts. Chronicles sets out the division more plainly than 2 Kings 11:5-7.

decisions.choice: gatekeepers of the thresholds: guards at the temple entrances
decisions.reason: The thresholds are the doorways of the temple (2 Kings 12:10; 1 Chronicles 9:19). The Levite gatekeepers had charge of them; here a third of those on duty guard them.

decisions.choice: will be divided into three groups. One group; temple
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the division into three that verses 4-5 imply (m3), as in 2 Kings 11:5, and says which doors are meant (m4).

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 11:5
decisions.reason: Jehoiada's orders keep the Spanish of 2 Kings 11:5-8 at each level where the Hebrew is the same; the plural_you setting runs through them.

decisions.choice: "portiers" (Literal); "gardera les portes" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Les portiers" is the word the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets for the gatekeepers; Balanced and Readable make it a verb.

decisions.choice: mabawabu (L, B); walinzi wa malango (R)
decisions.reason: The Levite gatekeepers, as set in the terms note for these books.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada says "các anh" to the priests and Levites
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:5, the priest gives orders to men he treats as fellow servants of the temple.

decisions.choice: the opening of 2 Kings 11:5 in Portuguese; os porteiros; as soleiras (L), as entradas (B), as portas do templo (R)
decisions.reason: The order opens with the words of 2 Kings 11:5 in Portuguese at each level (m1), "a terça parte" (L), "um terço" (B), "três grupos" (R) and "entrar de serviço no sábado" included (m2). "Porteiros" is Chronicles' word for the Levite gatekeepers, as the shared rules for the book have it; the thresholds (m4) keep "soleira", the word of 2 Kings 12:10 in Portuguese, at Literal only.

source.text: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַיְס֑וֹד וְכָל־הָעָ֔ם בְּחַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and the third at [the] house of the king, and the third at [the] gate of the Foundation; and all the people in [the] courts of [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: and the third at the house of the king, and the third at the Gate of the Foundation; and all the people [shall be] in the courts of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: one third will be at the king's palace, and one third at the Foundation Gate. All the people will be in the courts of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Another group will be at the king's palace, and the third group at the Foundation Gate. All the people will stay in the courtyards of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: y la tercera parte en la casa del rey, y la tercera parte en la puerta del Cimiento; y todo el pueblo [estará] en los atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: otra tercera parte estará en el palacio del rey, y otra tercera parte en la puerta del Cimiento. Todo el pueblo estará en los atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Otro grupo estará en el palacio del rey, y el tercer grupo en la puerta del Cimiento. Todo el pueblo se quedará en los atrios del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: et le tiers à la maison du roi, et le tiers à la porte du Fondement ; et tout le peuple [sera] dans les cours de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: un tiers au palais du roi, et un tiers à la porte du Fondement. Tout le peuple se tiendra dans les cours de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Un autre groupe sera au palais du roi, et le troisième groupe à la porte du Fondement. Tout le peuple restera dans les cours du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: na theluthi moja kwenye nyumba ya mfalme, na theluthi moja kwenye Lango la Msingi; na watu wote [watakuwa] katika nyua za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: theluthi moja watakuwa kwenye ikulu ya mfalme, na theluthi moja kwenye Lango la Msingi. Watu wote watakuwa katika nyua za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kikundi kingine kitakuwa kwenye ikulu ya mfalme, na kikundi cha tatu kwenye Lango la Msingi. Watu wote watakaa katika nyua za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: một phần ba ở cung vua, và một phần ba ở Cổng Nền; còn toàn dân [sẽ ở] trong các sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: một phần ba ở cung vua, và một phần ba ở Cổng Nền. Toàn dân sẽ ở trong các sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Một nhóm khác ở cung vua, và nhóm thứ ba ở Cổng Nền. Toàn dân phải ở lại trong các sân của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 삼분의 일은 왕의 집에, 삼분의 일은 기초 문에 [있으시오]. 그리고 온 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰들에 [있을 것이오].
ko.B: 삼분의 일은 왕궁에, 삼분의 일은 기초 문에 있으시오. 온 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 뜰에 있어야 하오.
ko.R: 또 한 무리는 왕궁에 있고, 셋째 무리는 기초 문에 있으시오. 백성은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 뜰에 머물러 있어야 하오.

pt.L: e a terça parte na casa do rei, e a terça parte na Porta do Fundamento; e todo o povo [estará] nos pátios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: um terço no palácio do rei e um terço na Porta do Fundamento. Todo o povo ficará nos pátios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Outro grupo vai ficar no palácio do rei, e o terceiro grupo na Porta do Fundamento. Todo o povo vai ficar nos pátios do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: Kings has the Sur Gate and the gate behind the runners; Chronicles adds the people in the courts
decisions.reason: In 2 Kings 11:5-6 the three groups guard the palace, the Sur Gate and the gate behind the runners. Chronicles has the palace and the Foundation Gate, and adds that all the people are to stay in the courts of the temple.

decisions.choice: the Gate of the Foundation: a gate whose site is unknown
decisions.reason: This gate is named only here. It stands where 2 Kings 11:6 has "the gate of Sur"; in Hebrew the two names differ by little more than one letter.

decisions.choice: all the people in the courts: the crowd stays outside the temple building
decisions.reason: The people gathered from Judah (verse 2) wait in the open courts. Only priests and Levites may go into the house itself (verse 6).

decisions.choice: Another group; the third group
decisions.reason: Readable continues the three groups it named in verse 4.

decisions.choice: "la puerta del Cimiento"
decisions.reason: The name of the gate translated, as the English says "Foundation Gate" (m2).

decisions.choice: a Porta do Fundamento
decisions.reason: The gate named only here (m2) is written as a name, with capitals, as the English "Foundation Gate"; it stands where 2 Kings 11:6 has "a porta de Sur" in Portuguese. The rest of the verse follows 2 Kings 11:6 where it can and adds the people in the courts, as Chronicles does (m1).

source.text: וְאַל־יָב֣וֹא בֵית־יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י אִם־הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַמְשָׁרְתִ֣ים לַלְוִיִּ֔ם הֵ֥מָּה יָבֹ֖אוּ כִּי־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑מָּה וְכָל־הָעָ֔ם יִשְׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And let not come [into the] house of Yahweh except the priests and the [ones] ministering of the Levites; they will come, for holiness they [are]; and all the people will keep [the] charge of Yahweh.

en.L: And let no one come into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} except the priests and those of the Levites who minister; they may come in, for they [are] holy; and all the people shall keep the charge of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Let no one enter the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} except the priests and the Levites who minister there. They may enter, because they are holy, but all the people must keep the charge of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: No one is to go into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} except the priests and the Levites who are on duty. They may go in because they are holy. All the people must do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} requires and stay outside.

es.L: Y que no entre [nadie] en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sino los sacerdotes y los que sirven de los levitas; ellos entrarán, porque [son] santos; y todo el pueblo guardará el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Que nadie entre en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, excepto los sacerdotes y los levitas que ministran allí. Ellos pueden entrar, porque están consagrados; pero todo el pueblo debe guardar el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Nadie debe entrar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, excepto los sacerdotes y los levitas que estén de servicio. Ellos pueden entrar porque son santos. Todo el pueblo debe hacer lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} manda y quedarse afuera.

fr.L: Et que personne n’entre dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sauf les prêtres et ceux des Lévites qui font le service ; eux entreront, car ils [sont] saints ; et tout le peuple observera l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Que personne n’entre dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sauf les prêtres et les Lévites qui y font le service. Eux pourront entrer, car ils sont saints ; mais tout le peuple devra observer l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Personne ne doit entrer dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sauf les prêtres et les Lévites qui sont de service. Eux peuvent entrer, parce qu’ils sont saints. Tout le peuple doit faire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} demande et rester dehors.

sw.L: Wala asiingie [mtu] katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ila makuhani na wale wa Walawi wanaohudumu; hao wataingia, kwa maana wao [ni] watakatifu; na watu wote watashika agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asiingie katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} isipokuwa makuhani na Walawi wanaohudumu humo. Hao wanaweza kuingia kwa sababu ni watakatifu, lakini watu wote lazima washike agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote asiingie katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} isipokuwa makuhani na Walawi walio zamuni. Hao wanaweza kuingia kwa sababu ni watakatifu. Watu wote lazima wafanye yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayotaka, wakae nje.

vi.L: Đừng để ai vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngoài các thầy tế lễ và những người Lê-vi đang phục vụ; họ được vào, vì họ [là] thánh; còn toàn dân phải giữ điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} truyền.
vi.B: Không ai được vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngoài các thầy tế lễ và những người Lê-vi phục vụ tại đó. Họ được vào, vì họ là thánh, nhưng toàn dân phải tuân giữ điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} truyền.
vi.R: Không ai được vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngoài các thầy tế lễ và những người Lê-vi đang trực. Họ được vào vì họ là thánh. Toàn dân phải làm theo điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đòi hỏi và ở bên ngoài.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들과 레위인들 가운데 섬기는 자들 외에는 아무도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어오지 못하게 하시오. 그들은 거룩하니 들어와도 되오. 그리고 온 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 직무를 지켜야 하오.
ko.B: 제사장들과 그곳에서 섬기는 레위인들 외에는 아무도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어오지 못하게 하시오. 그들은 거룩하니 들어와도 되지만, 온 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 직무를 지켜야 하오.
ko.R: 제사장들과 근무하는 레위인들 말고는 아무도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 안에 들어가서는 안 되오. 그들은 거룩하므로 들어가도 되오. 그러나 백성은 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 정하신 대로 성전 밖에 머물러야 하오.

pt.L: E que ninguém entre na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a não ser os sacerdotes e os que servem dentre os levitas; eles entrarão, porque eles [são] santos; e todo o povo guardará o encargo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Ninguém entre na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a não ser os sacerdotes e os levitas que estão servindo. Eles podem entrar, porque são santos, mas todo o povo deve guardar o encargo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Ninguém pode entrar no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a não ser os sacerdotes e os levitas que estão de serviço. Eles podem entrar porque são santos. Todo o povo deve fazer o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} exige e ficar do lado de fora.

decisions.choice: only priests and ministering Levites may enter, for they are holy: Kings has the guard
decisions.reason: In 2 Kings 11:7 the two companies going off duty, soldiers of the guard, keep watch over the house of Yahweh for the king, and Kings has spoken of the Carites and the runners. Chronicles says instead: let no one enter the house of Yahweh except the priests and the ministering Levites, for they are holy. In Chronicles the guard inside the temple is made up of those who may lawfully be there.

decisions.choice: they are holy: set apart for service in the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The priests and Levites had been set apart for the work of Yahweh's house (Numbers 3:5-10; 18:1-7; 1 Chronicles 23:28-32). Others who came near the holy place were to die (Numbers 1:51; 18:7).

decisions.choice: keep the charge of Yahweh: do what Yahweh requires
decisions.reason: The phrase means to carry out a duty Yahweh has laid down (Leviticus 8:35; Numbers 9:19). Here the people's part is to stay in the courts and not enter the house.

decisions.choice: those of the Levites who minister: the Levites on duty
decisions.reason: The participle means those serving at the temple, the Levites whose turn it was.

decisions.choice: do what the LORD requires and stay outside
decisions.reason: Readable explains "keep the charge" and says what it means for the people here (m3).

decisions.choice: "santos" (L, R); "consagrados" (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "consagrados" for the holiness of men set apart for the sanctuary (m2); Literal and Readable keep "santos".

decisions.choice: guardar o encargo do SENHOR (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Guardar o encargo" keeps the Hebrew phrase for a duty God has laid down (m3), as the English keeps "keep the charge"; Readable says what it means here, as the English does.

source.text: וְהִקִּיפוּ֩ הַלְוִיִּ֨ם אֶת־הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְכֵלָ֣יו בְּיָד֔וֹ וְהַבָּ֥א אֶל־הַבַּ֖יִת יוּמָ֑ת וִֽהְי֥וּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּבֹא֥וֹ וּבְצֵאתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will surround the Levites the king all around, each man and his weapons in his hand, and the [one] coming into the house will be put to death; and be with the king in his coming in and in his going out.

en.L: And the Levites shall surround the king all around, each man with his weapons in his hand, and whoever comes into the house shall be put to death; and be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out."
en.B: The Levites are to surround the king on every side, each man with his weapons in hand. Anyone who comes into the house must be put to death. Stay with the king wherever he goes."
en.R: The Levites must form a circle around the king, every man holding his weapons. Anyone else who comes into the temple must be killed. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."

es.L: Y los levitas rodearán al rey por todos lados, cada uno con sus armas en la mano, y el que entre en la casa será muerto; y {{plural_you:estén|estad}} con el rey cuando entre y cuando salga».
es.B: Los levitas rodearán al rey por todos lados, cada uno con sus armas en la mano. Cualquiera que entre en la casa debe morir. {{plural_you:Acompañen|Acompañad}} al rey adondequiera que vaya».
es.R: Los levitas formarán un círculo alrededor del rey, cada uno con sus armas en la mano. Si alguien más entra en el templo, hay que matarlo. {{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} junto al rey adondequiera que vaya».

fr.L: Et les Lévites entoureront le roi tout autour, chacun ses armes à la main, et quiconque entrera dans la maison sera mis à mort ; et soyez avec le roi quand il entrera et quand il sortira. »
fr.B: Les Lévites entoureront le roi de tous côtés, chacun les armes à la main. Quiconque pénétrera dans la maison devra être mis à mort. Restez avec le roi partout où il ira. »
fr.R: Les Lévites formeront un cercle autour du roi, chacun tenant ses armes. Si quelqu’un d’autre entre dans le temple, tuez-le. Restez près du roi partout où il ira. »

sw.L: Nao Walawi watamzunguka mfalme pande zote, kila mtu na silaha zake mkononi mwake, na yeyote atakayeingia katika nyumba atauawa; nanyi mkae pamoja na mfalme aingiapo na atokapo."
sw.B: Walawi watamzunguka mfalme pande zote, kila mtu akiwa na silaha zake mkononi. Yeyote atakayeingia katika nyumba lazima auawe. Kaeni pamoja na mfalme popote aendapo."
sw.R: Walawi lazima wamzunguke mfalme, kila mtu akiwa ameshika silaha zake. Mtu mwingine yeyote atakayeingia hekaluni lazima auawe. Kaeni karibu na mfalme popote aendapo."

vi.L: Người Lê-vi sẽ vây quanh vua tứ phía, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay, và ai vào nhà sẽ bị giết; hãy ở với vua khi vua vào và khi vua ra."
vi.B: Người Lê-vi phải vây quanh vua tứ phía, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay. Ai vào nhà phải bị giết. Hãy ở bên vua bất cứ vua đi đâu."
vi.R: Người Lê-vi phải đứng thành vòng quanh vua, mỗi người cầm sẵn vũ khí. Người nào khác vào đền thờ phải bị giết. Hãy ở sát bên vua bất cứ vua đi đâu."

ko.L: 그리고 레위인들은 각자 손에 무기를 들고 왕을 사방으로 둘러싸시오. 그 집에 들어오는 자는 죽여야 하오. 왕이 들어오실 때에도 나가실 때에도 왕과 함께 있으시오."
ko.B: 레위인들은 각자 손에 무기를 들고 왕을 사방으로 둘러싸시오. 성전에 들어오는 사람은 누구든지 죽여야 하오. 왕께서 어디로 가시든지 왕 곁에 있으시오."
ko.R: 레위인들은 모두 무기를 들고 왕을 빙 둘러싸시오. 그 밖의 사람이 성전에 들어오면 누구든지 죽이시오. 왕께서 어디로 가시든지 왕 곁을 떠나지 마시오."

pt.L: E os levitas cercarão o rei ao redor, cada homem com as suas armas na mão, e quem entrar na casa será morto; e estejam com o rei quando ele entrar e quando ele sair."
pt.B: Os levitas devem cercar o rei por todos os lados, cada um com as suas armas na mão. Quem entrar no templo deve ser morto. Fiquem com o rei aonde quer que ele vá."
pt.R: Os levitas devem fazer um círculo em volta do rei, cada um segurando as suas armas. Qualquer outra pessoa que entrar no templo deve ser morta. Fiquem perto do rei aonde quer que ele vá."

decisions.choice: the Levites surround the king; whoever enters the house: Kings has the guards and the ranks
decisions.reason: The words are those of 2 Kings 11:8 with three differences. In Kings the guards surround the king; here it is the Levites. In Kings anyone who "comes into the ranks" is to die; here anyone who "comes into the house". And Kings says "going out and coming in", Chronicles "coming in and going out".

decisions.choice: whoever comes into the house: anyone not allowed to enter
decisions.reason: After verse 6 this means anyone other than the priests and Levites who tries to enter the temple, who would be a threat to the king.

decisions.choice: when he comes in and when he goes out: wherever he goes
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:8. Coming in and going out together cover all of a person's movements (Deuteronomy 28:6).

decisions.choice: the orders end here
decisions.reason: Jehoiada's words that began in verse 3 end with this verse; verse 8 tells how they were carried out.

decisions.choice: wherever he goes
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:8, Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m3).

decisions.choice: Anyone else
decisions.reason: Readable adds "else" to show that the priests and Levites are not meant (m2).

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 11:8 in Portuguese, with "os levitas", "a casa" (L), "o templo" (B, R) and "quando ele entrar e quando ele sair" (L)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 11:8 level by level and changes only what Chronicles changes (m1): the Levites surround the king, the one who enters comes into the house, not the ranks, and Literal follows Chronicles' order, coming in before going out. Balanced says "o templo" where "the house" alone names the building, as 1:18 sets it.

source.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל־יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַכֹּהֵן֒ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁ֔יו בָּאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יוֹצְאֵ֣י הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת כִּ֣י לֹ֥א פָטַ֛ר יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַֽמַּחְלְקֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And did the Levites and all Judah according to all that commanded Jehoiada the priest, and took each his men, [those] coming in [on] the sabbath with [those] going out [on] the sabbath, for not had dismissed Jehoiada the priest the divisions.

en.L: And the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and each took his men, those coming in on the sabbath with those going out on the sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest had not dismissed the divisions.
en.B: The Levites and all Judah did everything Jehoiada the priest had ordered. Each brought his men, both the ones who came on duty on the sabbath and the ones who went off duty that day, for Jehoiada the priest had not released the divisions.
en.R: The Levites and all the people of Judah did just what Jehoiada the priest told them. Each leader brought his men, both those who were starting their duty on the sabbath and those who were finishing it. Jehoiada the priest had not let any of the groups go home.

es.L: E hicieron los levitas y todo Judá conforme a todo lo que había mandado el sacerdote Joiada, y tomó cada uno a sus hombres, los que entraban el sábado con los que salían el sábado, porque el sacerdote Joiada no había despedido a los turnos.
es.B: Los levitas y todo Judá hicieron todo lo que el sacerdote Joiada había ordenado. Cada uno llevó a sus hombres, tanto a los que entraban de servicio el sábado como a los que salían ese día, porque el sacerdote Joiada no había dejado ir a los turnos.
es.R: Los levitas y toda la gente de Judá hicieron todo lo que el sacerdote Joiada les dijo. Cada jefe llevó a sus hombres, tanto a los que empezaban su servicio el sábado como a los que lo terminaban. El sacerdote Joiada no había dejado que ninguno de los grupos se fuera a casa.

fr.L: Et les Lévites et tout Juda firent selon tout ce qu’avait ordonné Yehoyada le prêtre, et ils prirent chacun ses hommes, ceux qui entraient le jour du sabbat avec ceux qui sortaient le jour du sabbat, car Yehoyada le prêtre n’avait pas renvoyé les classes.
fr.B: Les Lévites et tout Juda firent tout ce que Yehoyada le prêtre avait ordonné. Chacun prit ses hommes, ceux qui prenaient leur service le jour du sabbat comme ceux qui le quittaient ce jour-là, car Yehoyada le prêtre n’avait pas libéré les classes.
fr.R: Les Lévites et tous les gens de Juda ont fait exactement ce que Yehoyada le prêtre leur avait dit. Chaque chef a amené ses hommes, ceux qui commençaient leur service le jour du sabbat et ceux qui le finissaient. Yehoyada le prêtre n’avait laissé aucun groupe rentrer chez lui.

sw.L: Walawi na Yuda wote wakafanya sawasawa na yote aliyoamuru Yehoyada kuhani, kila mmoja akawachukua watu wake, wale walioingia siku ya Sabato pamoja na wale waliotoka siku ya Sabato, kwa maana Yehoyada kuhani hakuwa ameziruhusu zamu kuondoka.
sw.B: Walawi na Yuda wote walifanya kila kitu ambacho Yehoyada kuhani aliamuru. Kila mmoja akaleta watu wake, wale walioingia zamu siku ya Sabato na wale waliotoka zamu siku hiyo, kwa kuwa Yehoyada kuhani hakuwa ameziruhusu zamu kuondoka.
sw.R: Walawi na watu wote wa Yuda wakafanya kama Yehoyada kuhani alivyowaambia. Kila kiongozi akaleta watu wake, wale waliokuwa wakianza zamu siku ya Sabato na wale waliokuwa wakiimaliza. Yehoyada kuhani hakuwa ameruhusu kikundi chochote kurudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Người Lê-vi và cả Giu-đa làm theo mọi điều thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa đã truyền. Mỗi người đem người của mình, những người vào phiên ngày Sa-bát cùng với những người ra phiên ngày Sa-bát, vì thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa không cho các ban về.
vi.B: Người Lê-vi và cả Giu-đa làm đúng mọi điều thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa đã truyền. Mỗi người dẫn người của mình, cả những người vào phiên lẫn những người mãn phiên ngày Sa-bát, vì thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa không cho các ban được về.
vi.R: Người Lê-vi và toàn dân Giu-đa làm đúng như thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa đã bảo. Mỗi người chỉ huy dẫn người của mình đến, cả những người bắt đầu phiên trực ngày Sa-bát lẫn những người vừa hết phiên. Thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa không cho nhóm nào về nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 레위인들과 온 유다가 제사장 여호야다가 명령한 모든 것대로 행했다. 그리고 각자 자기 부하들, 곧 안식일에 들어오는 자들과 안식일에 나가는 자들을 데려왔다. 제사장 여호야다가 그 반열들을 돌려보내지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 레위인들과 온 유다는 제사장 여호야다가 명령한 대로 다 했다. 그들은 각자 안식일에 근무하러 들어오는 부하들과 근무를 마치고 나가는 부하들을 데려왔다. 제사장 여호야다가 그 반열들을 돌려보내지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 레위인들과 유다의 모든 사람이 제사장 여호야다가 말한 그대로 했다. 지휘자들은 저마다 안식일에 근무를 시작하는 부하들과 근무를 마치는 부하들을 모두 데려왔다. 제사장 여호야다가 어느 무리도 집에 돌려보내지 않았던 것이다.

pt.L: E os levitas e todo o Judá fizeram conforme tudo o que Joiada, o sacerdote, tinha ordenado, e cada um tomou os seus homens, os que entravam no sábado com os que saíam no sábado, pois Joiada, o sacerdote, não tinha dispensado as turmas.
pt.B: Os levitas e todo o Judá fizeram tudo o que o sacerdote Joiada tinha ordenado. Cada um trouxe os seus homens, tanto os que entravam de serviço no sábado como os que deixavam o serviço naquele dia, pois o sacerdote Joiada não tinha liberado as turmas.
pt.R: Os levitas e todo o povo de Judá fizeram exatamente o que o sacerdote Joiada lhes disse. Cada chefe levou os seus homens, tanto os que estavam começando o serviço no sábado como os que estavam terminando. O sacerdote Joiada não tinha deixado nenhuma das turmas ir para casa.

decisions.choice: the Levites and all Judah; the divisions not dismissed: Kings has the commanders
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11:9 says that "the commanders of hundreds" did as Jehoiada commanded and came to him. Chronicles says "the Levites and all Judah", and adds the reason both shifts were there: Jehoiada had not dismissed the divisions.

decisions.choice: the divisions: the groups of priests and Levites who served by turns
decisions.reason: David had arranged the priests and Levites in divisions that took turns at the temple (1 Chronicles 23:6; 24:1-19). By keeping the outgoing division at the temple, Jehoiada doubled the number of men on hand.

decisions.choice: both shifts together
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:9: the men coming on duty and those going off duty were both present.

decisions.choice: Each leader; go home
decisions.reason: Readable says who brought the men and what being "dismissed" would have meant.

decisions.choice: "los turnos" (L, B); "los grupos" (R)
decisions.reason: The divisions of priests and Levites who served by turns (m2).

decisions.choice: "les classes"
decisions.reason: The usual French word for the groups of priests and Levites who served by turns (Luke 1:5).

decisions.choice: "các ban"
decisions.reason: The divisions of priests and Levites who served by turns (m2); "ban" is the word for a shift of temple service.

decisions.choice: "반열" for the divisions of priests and Levites
decisions.reason: The Korean Bible word for the courses in which priests served by turns (m2); Readable says "무리".

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 11:9 in Portuguese, with "os levitas e todo o Judá" and "as turmas"
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 11:9 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' subject, the Levites and all Judah, and its added reason (m1). The divisions (m2) are "as turmas", as 5:11 sets them for the book.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֗וֹת אֶת־הַֽחֲנִיתִים֙ וְאֶת־הַמָּגִנּוֹת֙ וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave Jehoiada the priest to [the] commanders of the hundreds the spears and the shields and the shields which [were] to the king David, which [were in the] house of the God.

en.L: And Jehoiada the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spears and the bucklers and the shields that [had belonged] to King David, which [were in] the house of God.
en.B: Jehoiada the priest gave the commanders of hundreds the spears and the two kinds of shields that had belonged to King David and were kept in the house of God.
en.R: Jehoiada the priest handed out to the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David. They were kept in God's temple.

es.L: Y el sacerdote Joiada dio a los jefes de cien las lanzas, los escudos pequeños y los escudos que [habían sido] del rey David, que [estaban en] la casa de Dios.
es.B: El sacerdote Joiada les entregó a los jefes de cien las lanzas y las dos clases de escudos que habían sido del rey David y que se guardaban en la casa de Dios.
es.R: El sacerdote Joiada les repartió a los jefes las lanzas y los escudos que habían sido del rey David. Se guardaban en el templo de Dios.

fr.L: Et Yehoyada le prêtre donna aux chefs de centaines les lances, et les petits boucliers, et les boucliers qui [avaient appartenu] au roi David, qui [étaient dans] la maison de Dieu.
fr.B: Yehoyada le prêtre remit aux chefs de centaines les lances et les deux sortes de boucliers qui avaient appartenu au roi David et qu’on gardait dans la maison de Dieu.
fr.R: Yehoyada le prêtre a distribué aux chefs les lances et les boucliers qui avaient appartenu au roi David. Ils étaient gardés dans le temple de Dieu.

sw.L: Yehoyada kuhani akawapa wakuu wa mamia mikuki na ngao ndogo na ngao [zilizokuwa] za mfalme Daudi, zilizokuwa [katika] nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.B: Yehoyada kuhani akawapa wakuu wa mamia mikuki na ngao za aina mbili zilizokuwa mali ya mfalme Daudi, zilizowekwa katika nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.R: Yehoyada kuhani akawagawia makamanda mikuki na ngao zilizokuwa mali ya mfalme Daudi. Zilikuwa zimewekwa katika hekalu la Mungu.

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa trao cho các chỉ huy trăm người những cây giáo, những cái thuẫn và những cái khiên của vua Đa-vít, là những thứ [ở trong] nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa trao cho các chỉ huy trăm người những cây giáo cùng hai loại khiên trước kia của vua Đa-vít, được cất giữ trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa phát cho các chỉ huy những cây giáo và những cái khiên trước kia của vua Đa-vít. Những vũ khí này được cất giữ trong đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장 여호야다가 하나님의 집에 있던, 다윗 왕의 [것이었던] 창들과 작은 방패들과 방패들을 백부장들에게 주었다.
ko.B: 제사장 여호야다는 하나님의 집에 보관되어 있던 다윗 왕의 창들과 두 가지 방패를 백부장들에게 주었다.
ko.R: 제사장 여호야다는 다윗 왕의 것이었던 창과 방패들을 지휘관들에게 나누어 주었다. 그것들은 하나님의 성전에 보관되어 있었다.

pt.L: E Joiada, o sacerdote, deu aos chefes de centenas as lanças e os broquéis e os escudos que [tinham sido] do rei Davi, que [estavam na] casa de Deus.
pt.B: O sacerdote Joiada entregou aos comandantes de centenas as lanças e os dois tipos de escudo que tinham pertencido ao rei Davi e que estavam guardados na casa de Deus.
pt.R: O sacerdote Joiada entregou aos comandantes as lanças e os escudos que tinham sido do rei Davi. Eles estavam guardados no templo de Deus.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada named; spears plural; a second word for shields; the house of God
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11:10 says "the priest gave ... the spear and the shields that had belonged to King David, which were in the house of Yahweh". Chronicles names Jehoiada, has the plural "spears", adds a second word for shields, and says "the house of God".

decisions.choice: bucklers and shields: two kinds of shield
decisions.reason: The first word is the common round shield carried by a soldier. The second is the rare word of 2 Kings 11:10, used for the gold pieces David took from Hadadezer's officers (2 Samuel 8:7); it was most likely a kind of shield, though some take it as quivers.

decisions.choice: David's weapons in the temple: trophies kept at the house of God
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:10. Weapons won in battle were kept in a sanctuary as a sign of victory (2 Samuel 8:7, 11). Arming the guard with David's weapons tied the new king to David's line.

decisions.choice: the bucklers and the shields (Literal); the two kinds of shields (Balanced); shields (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two words apart, with "shields" for the word used in 2 Kings 11:10; Balanced says there were two kinds; Readable simply says "shields".

decisions.choice: "los escudos pequeños y los escudos" (L); "las dos clases de escudos" (B); "los escudos" (R)
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words for shields, one wording per level as the English has (m2).

decisions.choice: "les petits boucliers, et les boucliers"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two Hebrew words apart; French "petits boucliers" says what the first word means without a rare word.

decisions.choice: as lanças; os broquéis e os escudos (L), os dois tipos de escudo (B), os escudos (R)
alternatives: os escudos pequenos e os grandes
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 11:10 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' plural "lanças" and its second word for shields (m1, m2): Literal calls the common round shield "broquel" and keeps "escudos" for the word of 2 Kings 11:10, as the English keeps "bucklers" and "shields" apart; Balanced says there were two kinds, and Readable says "escudos".

source.text: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד אֶת־כָּל־הָעָ֜ם וְאִ֣ישׁ׀שִׁלְח֣וֹ בְיָד֗וֹ מִכֶּ֨תֶף הַבַּ֤יִת הַיְמָנִית֙ עַד־כֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֨יִת֙ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְלַבָּ֑יִת עַל־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he stationed all the people, and each [had] his weapon in his hand, from [the] side of the house the right to [the] side of the house the left, by the altar and by the house, by the king all around.

en.L: And he stationed all the people, each man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, by the altar and by the house, around the king on every side.
en.B: He stationed all the people, each man with his weapon in hand, from the south side of the temple to the north side, beside the altar and the temple, surrounding the king.
en.R: He put all the people in their places, each man holding his weapon. They formed a line from the south side of the temple to the north side, near the altar and the temple building, to surround and protect the king.

es.L: Y apostó a todo el pueblo, cada uno con su arma en la mano, desde el lado derecho de la casa hasta el lado izquierdo de la casa, junto al altar y junto a la casa, alrededor del rey.
es.B: Colocó a todo el pueblo, cada uno con su arma en la mano, desde el lado sur del templo hasta el lado norte, junto al altar y al templo, rodeando al rey.
es.R: Puso a todo el pueblo en sus puestos, cada uno con su arma en la mano. Formaron una fila desde el lado sur del templo hasta el lado norte, cerca del altar y del edificio del templo, para rodear y proteger al rey.

fr.L: Et il plaça tout le peuple, chacun son arme à la main, depuis le côté droit de la maison jusqu’au côté gauche de la maison, près de l’autel et près de la maison, autour du roi.
fr.B: Il posta tout le peuple, chacun l’arme à la main, du côté sud du temple jusqu’au côté nord, près de l’autel et du temple, tout autour du roi.
fr.R: Il a mis tout le peuple à sa place, chacun tenant son arme. Ils ont formé une ligne du côté sud du temple jusqu’au côté nord, près de l’autel et du bâtiment du temple, pour entourer et protéger le roi.

sw.L: Akawaweka watu wote, kila mtu na silaha yake mkononi mwake, kutoka upande wa kulia wa nyumba mpaka upande wa kushoto wa nyumba, karibu na madhabahu na karibu na nyumba, kumzunguka mfalme pande zote.
sw.B: Akawaweka watu wote mahali pao, kila mtu akiwa na silaha yake mkononi, kutoka upande wa kusini wa hekalu mpaka upande wa kaskazini, kando ya madhabahu na hekalu, wakimzunguka mfalme.
sw.R: Akawaweka watu wote mahali pao, kila mtu akiwa ameshika silaha yake. Wakasimama mstari kutoka upande wa kusini wa hekalu mpaka upande wa kaskazini, karibu na madhabahu na jengo la hekalu, ili kumzunguka mfalme na kumlinda.

vi.L: Ông đặt toàn dân, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay, từ phía bên phải của nhà đến phía bên trái của nhà, cạnh bàn thờ và cạnh nhà, vây quanh vua tứ phía.
vi.B: Ông cho toàn dân vào vị trí, mỗi người cầm vũ khí trong tay, từ phía nam đền thờ đến phía bắc, cạnh bàn thờ và đền thờ, vây quanh vua.
vi.R: Ông cho toàn dân đứng vào vị trí, tay cầm vũ khí. Họ dàn thành hàng từ phía nam đến phía bắc đền thờ, gần bàn thờ và tòa nhà đền thờ, để vây quanh bảo vệ vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 온 백성을 세웠는데, 각자 손에 그의 무기를 들고 그 집의 오른쪽에서부터 그 집의 왼쪽까지, 제단과 그 집 곁에, 왕을 사방으로 둘러싸게 했다.
ko.B: 그는 온 백성을 각자 손에 무기를 들고 성전 남쪽에서부터 북쪽까지 제단과 성전 곁에 늘어서서 왕을 둘러싸게 했다.
ko.R: 그는 온 백성을 각자 자리에 세웠다. 그들은 저마다 무기를 들고 성전 남쪽에서부터 북쪽까지 제단과 성전 건물 가까이에 줄을 지어 서서, 왕을 둘러싸고 지켰다.

pt.L: E ele posicionou todo o povo, cada homem com a sua arma na mão, desde o lado direito da casa até o lado esquerdo da casa, junto ao altar e junto à casa, ao redor do rei.
pt.B: Ele posicionou todo o povo, cada um com a sua arma na mão, desde o lado sul do templo até o lado norte, junto ao altar e ao templo, em volta do rei.
pt.R: Ele colocou todo o povo nos seus lugares, cada um segurando a sua arma. Eles formaram uma linha do lado sul do templo até o lado norte, perto do altar e do prédio do templo, para cercar e proteger o rei.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada stations all the people: in Kings the runners take their places
decisions.reason: The words follow 2 Kings 11:11, where "the runners stood, each man with his weapons in his hand". In Chronicles Jehoiada stations "all the people", and the word for weapon is a different one (m3).

decisions.choice: right side, left side: south side, north side
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:11. Directions were named facing east, the way the temple faced, so "right" is south and "left" is north.

decisions.choice: his weapon: a hand weapon, perhaps a javelin
decisions.reason: This word for a weapon is less common than the general word in verse 7. It may name a spear or javelin, or any weapon in general (Nehemiah 4:11, 17).

decisions.choice: the altar and the house: the court in front of the temple
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:11. The altar for burnt offerings stood in the court before the temple building, where the king would be shown.

decisions.choice: south side; north side
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the compass directions that "right" and "left" mean here (m2).

decisions.choice: to surround and protect the king
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:11, Readable adds "protect" to make the purpose clear (verse 7).

decisions.choice: posicionou todo o povo; a sua arma (singular)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 11:11 at each level, with Chronicles' changes (m1): Jehoiada stations the people, where Kings has the guards take their places, and the weapon is singular, "a sua arma", for the less common word of this verse (m3).

source.text: וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ אֶת־הַנֵּ֨זֶר֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣עֵד֔וּת וַיַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻ֨הוּ֙ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע וּבָנָ֔יו וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they brought out the son of the king and put on him the crown and the testimony, and made king him; and anointed him Jehoiada and his sons, and said, may live the king.

en.L: And they brought out the son of the king and put on him the crown and the testimony, and they made him king; and Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, "May the king live!"
en.B: Then they brought out the king's son and put on him the crown and the testimony. They made him king, and Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and shouted, "Long live the king!"
en.R: Then they brought out the king's son. They put the crown on him and the testimony, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons poured olive oil on his head, and they shouted, "Long live the king!"

es.L: Y sacaron al hijo del rey y pusieron sobre él la corona y el testimonio, y lo hicieron rey; y Joiada y sus hijos lo ungieron, y dijeron: «¡Viva el rey!».
es.B: Entonces sacaron al hijo del rey y le pusieron la corona y el testimonio. Lo proclamaron rey, y Joiada y sus hijos lo ungieron y gritaron: «¡Viva el rey!».
es.R: Entonces sacaron al hijo del rey. Le pusieron la corona y le entregaron el testimonio, y lo hicieron rey. Joiada y sus hijos le derramaron aceite de oliva sobre la cabeza, y gritaron: «¡Viva el rey!».

fr.L: Et ils firent sortir le fils du roi et mirent sur lui le diadème et le témoignage, et ils le firent roi ; et Yehoyada et ses fils l’oignirent, et ils dirent : « Que vive le roi ! »
fr.B: Puis on fit sortir le fils du roi et on lui remit le diadème et le témoignage. On le proclama roi, et Yehoyada et ses fils l’oignirent en criant : « Vive le roi ! »
fr.R: Ensuite ils ont fait sortir le fils du roi. Ils lui ont mis le diadème sur la tête et lui ont remis le témoignage, et ils l’ont fait roi. Yehoyada et ses fils lui ont versé de l’huile d’olive sur la tête, et ils ont crié : « Vive le roi ! »

sw.L: Wakamtoa mwana wa mfalme, wakamvika taji na Ushuhuda, wakamfanya mfalme; naye Yehoyada na wanawe wakampaka mafuta, wakasema, "Mfalme na aishi!"
sw.B: Kisha wakamtoa mwana wa mfalme, wakamvika taji na kumpa Ushuhuda. Wakamfanya mfalme, naye Yehoyada na wanawe wakampaka mafuta, wakapaza sauti, "Mfalme aishi milele!"
sw.R: Kisha wakamtoa mwana wa mfalme. Wakamvika taji na kumpa Ushuhuda, wakamfanya mfalme. Yehoyada na wanawe wakamimina mafuta ya zeituni juu ya kichwa chake, nao wakapaza sauti, "Mfalme aishi milele!"

vi.L: Họ đưa con trai vua ra, đội vương miện cho cậu và trao bản chứng ước, rồi lập cậu làm vua; Giê-hô-gia-đa và các con trai ông xức dầu cho cậu, và họ nói: "Vua vạn tuế!"
vi.B: Rồi họ đưa hoàng tử ra, đội vương miện cho cậu và trao bản chứng ước. Họ lập cậu làm vua, rồi Giê-hô-gia-đa và các con trai ông xức dầu cho cậu, và họ hô lên: "Vua vạn tuế!"
vi.R: Rồi họ đưa hoàng tử ra. Họ đội vương miện cho cậu, trao cho cậu bản chứng ước, và lập cậu làm vua. Giê-hô-gia-đa và các con trai ông đổ dầu ô-liu trên đầu cậu, và mọi người hô lên: "Vua vạn tuế!"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 왕의 아들을 데리고 나와서 그에게 왕관을 씌우고 증거를 [주었다]. 그리고 그들이 그를 왕으로 세웠다. 그리고 여호야다와 그의 아들들이 그에게 기름을 붓고 말했다. "왕이 사시기를!"
ko.B: 그들은 왕자를 데리고 나와서 그에게 왕관을 씌우고 증거의 말씀을 주었다. 그들은 그를 왕으로 세웠고, 여호야다와 그의 아들들은 그에게 기름을 붓고 외쳤다. "왕 만세!"
ko.R: 그들은 왕자를 데리고 나왔다. 그리고 그에게 왕관을 씌우고 하나님의 언약의 말씀을 적은 증거를 주었다. 그들은 그를 왕으로 세웠다. 여호야다와 그의 아들들은 그의 머리에 올리브기름을 붓고 외쳤다. "왕 만세!"

pt.L: E trouxeram para fora o filho do rei e puseram sobre ele a coroa e o Testemunho, e o fizeram rei; e Joiada e os seus filhos o ungiram, e disseram: "Viva o rei!"
pt.B: Então trouxeram para fora o filho do rei e puseram sobre ele a coroa e o Testemunho. Eles o proclamaram rei, e Joiada e os seus filhos o ungiram e gritaram: "Viva o rei!"
pt.R: Então trouxeram para fora o filho do rei. Puseram no menino a coroa e o Testemunho e o fizeram rei. Joiada e os seus filhos derramaram azeite na cabeça dele, e todos gritaram: "Viva o rei!"

decisions.choice: the testimony: probably a written copy of Yahweh's covenant law
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:12. The word is used for the covenant law, especially the tablets kept in the ark (Exodus 25:16, 21). The king was to have his own copy of the law (Deuteronomy 17:18-19), and this may be what was given to Joash at his crowning. Because Saul's crown is paired with an armband in 2 Samuel 1:10, and the two Hebrew words look alike, some think this was a royal ornament rather than a document.

decisions.choice: they brought out; Jehoiada and his sons anointed him; no clapping
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11:12 has "he brought out" and "they anointed him", and adds that the people clapped their hands. Chronicles has "they brought out", names Jehoiada and his sons, priests, as the ones who anointed the king, and does not mention the clapping.

decisions.choice: may the king live: the acclamation of a new king
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:12. This is the cry with which the people welcomed a new king (1 Samuel 10:24; 1 Kings 1:39).

decisions.choice: the crown: the sign of a consecrated ruler
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:12. The word names the royal crown (2 Samuel 1:10) and also the high priest's holy diadem (Exodus 29:6).

decisions.choice: Long live the king!
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:12, Balanced and Readable use the familiar English acclamation; Literal keeps the Hebrew form.

decisions.choice: the testimony
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:12, every level keeps "testimony", the singular used for the covenant tablets, because the sense here is uncertain (m1).

decisions.choice: poured olive oil on his head
decisions.reason: Readable explains what anointing is, as in 2 Kings 11:12.

decisions.choice: "el testimonio"; "¡Viva el rey!"
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 11:12, at each level.

decisions.choice: "bản chứng ước"; "Vua vạn tuế!"
decisions.reason: The 2 Kings 11:12 drafts' wording for the testimony and the acclamation, kept for the same event.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 11:12, with "그들이" bringing him out, Jehoiada and his sons anointing him and no clapping
decisions.reason: Only what the Hebrew of Chronicles changes is changed (m2).

decisions.choice: Viva o rei! (every level); o Testemunho; Joiada e os seus filhos
decisions.reason: The crowning keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 11:12: "Viva o rei!" at every level, "o Testemunho" with its capital (m1), and Readable's "derramaram azeite na cabeça dele" for anointing. What Chronicles changes is changed (m2): "they" brought him out, Jehoiada and his sons anoint him, and there is no clapping.

source.text: וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֗הוּ אֶת־ק֤וֹל הָעָם֙ הָֽרָצִ֔ים וְהַֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתָּב֥וֹא אֶל־הָעָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard Athaliah the sound of the people, the [ones] running and the [ones] praising the king, and came to the people [to the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And Athaliah heard the sound of the people running and praising the king, and she came to the people [in] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people as they ran and praised the king, she went to the people at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering for the king. So she went to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, where the people were.

es.L: Y oyó Atalía el ruido del pueblo que corría y aclamaba al rey, y vino al pueblo [en] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cuando Atalía oyó el ruido del pueblo que corría y aclamaba al rey, fue adonde estaba el pueblo, en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Atalía oyó el ruido de la gente que corría y vitoreaba al rey. Entonces fue al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, donde estaba el pueblo.

fr.L: Et Athalie entendit le bruit du peuple qui courait et acclamait le roi, et elle vint vers le peuple [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Quand Athalie entendit le bruit du peuple qui accourait et acclamait le roi, elle se rendit auprès du peuple, à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Athalie a entendu le bruit du peuple qui courait et acclamait le roi. Alors elle est allée au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, où se trouvait le peuple.

sw.L: Athalia aliposikia sauti ya watu wakikimbia na kumsifu mfalme, akaja kwa watu [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Athalia aliposikia kelele za watu walipokuwa wakikimbia na kumsifu mfalme, alikwenda kwa watu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Athalia alisikia kelele za watu waliokuwa wakikimbia na kumshangilia mfalme. Basi akaenda katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, walipokuwa watu.

vi.L: A-tha-li nghe tiếng dân chúng chạy và ca tụng vua, bèn đến với dân chúng [ở] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Khi A-tha-li nghe tiếng ồn ào của dân chúng chạy đến và ca tụng vua, bà đến chỗ dân chúng ở nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: A-tha-li nghe tiếng ồn ào của dân chúng đang chạy và tung hô vua. Vậy bà đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nơi dân chúng đang tụ họp.

ko.L: 그리고 아달랴가 달려가며 왕을 찬양하는 백성의 소리를 듣고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있는 백성에게로 왔다.
ko.B: 아달랴는 백성이 달려가며 왕을 찬양하는 소리를 듣고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 모인 백성에게로 갔다.
ko.R: 아달랴는 백성이 뛰어다니며 왕을 환호하는 소리를 들었다. 그래서 백성이 모여 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 갔다.

pt.L: E Atalia ouviu o som do povo que corria e louvava o rei, e foi até o povo [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Quando Atalia ouviu o barulho do povo, que corria e aclamava o rei, foi até o povo na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Atalia ouviu o barulho do povo correndo e aplaudindo o rei. Então foi até o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, onde o povo estava.

decisions.choice: the people running and praising the king: Kings has the runners and the people
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11:13 has "the sound of the runners, the people", the guards and the crowd. Chronicles has "the sound of the people running and praising the king": the word for the guards becomes people running, and the praise of the king is added.

decisions.choice: praising the king: acclaiming him
decisions.reason: The verb is the usual word for praise. Here it is the crowd's shouts in honor of the new king (verse 11).

decisions.choice: she came to the people: Athaliah goes into the temple court
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:13. She came into the place where the guard had been set (verses 4-10).

decisions.choice: cheering for
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for the people's praise of the king (m2).

decisions.choice: o povo que corria e louvava (L), aclamava (B), aplaudindo (R) o rei
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 11:13 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' people running and praising the king where Kings has the guards and the people (m1). Balanced says "aclamava" for the crowd's shouts in honor of a king (m2); Readable "aplaudindo", as the English says "cheering".

source.text: וַתֵּ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּ֣ה הַמֶּלֶךְ֩ עוֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־עַמּוּד֜וֹ בַּמָּב֗וֹא וְהַשָּׂרִ֣ים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת֮ עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְכָל־עַ֨ם הָאָ֜רֶץ שָׂמֵ֗חַ וְתוֹקֵ֨עַ֙ בַּחֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת וְהַמְשֽׁוֹרֲרִים֙ בִּכְלֵ֣י הַשִּׁ֔יר וּמוֹדִיעִ֖ים לְהַלֵּ֑ל וַתִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶת־בְּגָדֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And she looked, and look, the king [was] standing by his pillar at the entrance, and the commanders and the trumpets [were] by the king, and all [the] people of the land [were] rejoicing and blowing on trumpets, and the singers with [the] instruments of the song and leading [in] praise; and tore Athaliah her clothes and said, Conspiracy, conspiracy.

en.L: And she looked, and look, the king [was] standing by his pillar at the entrance, and the commanders and the trumpets [were] beside the king, and all the people of the land [were] rejoicing and blowing on trumpets, and the singers with the instruments of song [were] leading the praise; and Athaliah tore her clothes and said, "Treason! Treason!"
en.B: She looked, and there was the king, standing by his pillar at the entrance, with the commanders and the trumpeters beside him. All the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and the singers with their musical instruments were leading the praise. Athaliah tore her clothes and cried out, "Treason! Treason!"
en.R: She looked and saw the new king standing by his pillar at the entrance. The commanders and the trumpet players were next to him. All the people of the land were celebrating and blowing trumpets. The singers were playing their instruments and leading the people in praise. Athaliah tore her clothes and screamed, "Treason! Treason!"

es.L: Y miró, y he aquí que el rey [estaba] de pie junto a su columna a la entrada, y los jefes y las trompetas [estaban] junto al rey, y todo el pueblo de la tierra [estaba] alegre y tocaba las trompetas, y los cantores con los instrumentos de música dirigían la alabanza. Y Atalía rasgó sus vestidos y dijo: «¡Traición! ¡Traición!».
es.B: Miró, y allí estaba el rey, de pie junto a su columna a la entrada, con los jefes y los trompeteros a su lado. Todo el pueblo de la tierra estaba alegre y tocaba las trompetas, y los cantores con sus instrumentos de música dirigían la alabanza. Atalía se rasgó las vestiduras y gritó: «¡Traición! ¡Traición!».
es.R: Miró y vio al nuevo rey de pie junto a su columna, a la entrada. Los jefes y los que tocaban la trompeta estaban a su lado. Todo el pueblo de la tierra celebraba y tocaba las trompetas. Los cantores tocaban sus instrumentos y dirigían al pueblo en la alabanza. Atalía se rasgó la ropa y gritó: «¡Traición! ¡Traición!».

fr.L: Et elle regarda, et voici, le roi se tenait près de sa colonne à l’entrée, et les chefs et les trompettes [étaient] près du roi, et tout le peuple du pays se réjouissait et sonnait des trompettes, et les chanteurs, avec les instruments de musique, dirigeaient la louange ; et Athalie déchira ses vêtements et dit : « Conspiration ! Conspiration ! »
fr.B: Elle regarda : le roi se tenait près de sa colonne, à l’entrée, avec les chefs et les trompettes à ses côtés. Tout le peuple du pays était dans la joie et sonnait des trompettes, et les chanteurs, avec leurs instruments de musique, dirigeaient la louange. Athalie déchira ses vêtements et cria : « Trahison ! Trahison ! »
fr.R: Elle a regardé et elle a vu le nouveau roi debout près de sa colonne, à l’entrée. Les chefs et les joueurs de trompette étaient à côté de lui. Tout le peuple du pays faisait la fête et sonnait des trompettes. Les chanteurs jouaient de leurs instruments et dirigeaient la louange du peuple. Athalie a déchiré ses vêtements et elle a hurlé : « Trahison ! Trahison ! »

sw.L: Akatazama, na tazama, mfalme [alikuwa] amesimama karibu na nguzo yake kwenye maingilio, na wakuu na tarumbeta [walikuwa] karibu na mfalme, na watu wote wa nchi [walikuwa] wakishangilia na kupiga tarumbeta, na waimbaji wenye vyombo vya kuimbia [walikuwa] wakiongoza sifa. Athalia akararua mavazi yake, akasema, "Uhaini! Uhaini!"
sw.B: Akatazama, na pale alikuwa mfalme amesimama karibu na nguzo yake kwenye maingilio, pamoja na wakuu na wapiga tarumbeta kando yake. Watu wote wa nchi walikuwa wakishangilia na kupiga tarumbeta, na waimbaji wenye vyombo vyao vya muziki walikuwa wakiongoza sifa. Athalia akararua mavazi yake, akalia, "Uhaini! Uhaini!"
sw.R: Akatazama, akamwona mfalme mpya amesimama karibu na nguzo yake kwenye maingilio. Makamanda na wapiga tarumbeta walikuwa karibu naye. Watu wote wa nchi walikuwa wakisherehekea na kupiga tarumbeta. Waimbaji walikuwa wakipiga vyombo vyao na kuwaongoza watu katika sifa. Athalia akararua mavazi yake, akapiga kelele, "Uhaini! Uhaini!"
